releases.notes:
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented here. The format is based on
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and this project adheres to
[Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [2.3.5] - 2026-06-14

### Changed
- Version bump to 2.3.5. Consolidated release containing the full feature set: six evolved
  goals, mob coordination, threat assessment, dedicated observers, complete Evolution Index
  model, public API, mob-state data attachments, evolved pathfinding, profiling tools and the
  opt-in client debug overlay.

## [1.0.0] - 2026-06-14

### Added
- Dual-layer evolution engine (global "intelligence floor" + per-player adaptation, blended 40/60).
- Server-thread observer pipeline feeding a lock-free queue drained by a dedicated analytics thread.
- Behaviour fingerprinting: weapon usage, shield rate, crit rate, retreat frequency, kite distance.
- Pattern-lock detection with confidence growth and time-based expiry.
- Weighted goal scoring with stage gating and the Fairness Doctrine (`FairnessValidator`).
- Six evolved goals injected non-destructively via `ServerEntityEvents.ENTITY_LOAD`:
  `FlankTargetGoal`, `SeekCoverGoal`, `WallTargetingGoal`, `SleepDisruptionGoal`,
  `EvolvingMeleeGoal` and `CoordinatedAttackGoal`, with flank/cover position calculators.
- Mob coordination subsystem: `MobCoordinationService`, `CoordinationGroup` (weak-ref members),
  `RoleAssigner` and distance-based striker/distractor/flanker/reserve roles.
- Threat assessment (`ThreatAssessor` + pure `ThreatScore`) and co-op tracking (`CoopObserver`)
  for fair pressure distribution and isolation handling.
- Dedicated observers: combat, sleep, movement (retreat/kite), inventory (weapon/armour) and
  base-structure (perimeter classification); `SpatialCache` chunk hostile-density index.
- Server→client debug overlay (`DebugOverlayPayload`, `DebugOverlayService`, client HUD) and the
  `/sme overlay` toggle.
- Complete Evolution Index model: shield milestones, pattern-lock bonus, base-archetype gain,
  in-game-day survival, real-hour passive gain, and inactivity-only player decay.
- Public API: `EvolutionAPI` facade, immutable `EvolutionState`, and the `EvolutionEvents`
  `STAGE_CHANGED` Fabric event for external mods.
- Per-mob state machine (`MobState`) stored via a transient Fabric data attachment
  (`SMEAttachments`, `MobDataAttachment`).
- `EvolvedPathfinder`: additive path augmentation with transparent fallback to vanilla pursuit.
- Profiling and diagnostics: `GCPressureMonitor`, `ProfilerIntegration` (section timings),
  `EvolutionDumper` (`/sme dump`), surfaced through `/sme perf`.
- Mod icon and expanded documentation (architecture, adaptation fairness ratings).
- Difficulty-aware hard caps (Peaceful disables the system entirely) and per-day EI decay.
- Versioned NBT persistence with V1→V2 schema migration.
- Tick-budget guard with automatic emergency throttle and recovery.
- `/sme` operator command tree (`status`, `perf`, `player`, `global reset`).
- Fail-safe config loader (`config/smart-mob-evolution.json`) that falls back to defaults.
- Unit test suite for the evolution index, pattern detector, scorer and fairness validator.

[2.3.5]: https://github.com/X1NPAR1/smart-mob-evolution/releases/tag/v2.3.5
[1.0.0]: https://github.com/X1NPAR1/smart-mob-evolution/releases/tag/v1.0.0


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/X1NPAR1/smart-mob-evolution/compare/v1.0.0...v2.3.5
